verdict.rationale: Ramp's own marketing documents hotel rate monitoring with automatic rebooking when prices drop by $50 or more, so the core capability is first-party. Support is limited to hotels, applies only above a $50 threshold, and rests on a single one-line claim. missing for 10: coverage of flights and other booked travel beyond hotels, detailed docs on how monitoring and rebooking work (cadence, policy controls, agent/API access), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have booked travel rates automatically monitored and rebooked when prices drop

citations.quote: Hotel rate monitoring with automatic rebooking when prices drop $50+
